source_summary: Tall vertical Chinese landscape with a monumental central mountain, layered ridges, wooded valleys, village pavilions, paths, scholar figures, a bridge, stream, rocks, and dense ink-textured trees; calligraphy and seals are excluded.

motifs.name: central_mountain_massif
motifs.description: Dominant tan-and-gray mountain peak with steep shoulders, nested ravines, pale wash slopes, and dense dark cun-texture strokes descending into the central valley; isolate the peak and mountain body without the village buildings below.
must_preserve: rounded summit contour and small dark cap behind it
pale ochre wash over the broad central face
fine vertical and diagonal ink texture strokes on both flanks
dark broken rock outlines along ravines
soft misty fading at lower valley edge

motifs.name: upper_left_distant_ridges
motifs.description: Receding gray mountain forms at the upper left, partly hidden behind nearer ochre slopes, with soft silhouettes and sparse texture marks.
must_preserve: muted blue-gray wash silhouettes
rounded rear peak shapes
thin dark ridge outlines
light atmospheric separation from foreground slopes
small texture strokes on the nearer left ravine

motifs.name: right_stratified_cliff
motifs.description: Vertical cliff and rocky wall on the mid-right side, with horizontal ink strata, pale ledges, and small trees at its foot.
must_preserve: stacked horizontal ink lines on the cliff face
pale ochre wash on ledges
dark vertical cracks and broken edges
tiny upright tree marks along the base and right edge
soft transition into adjacent hillside wash

motifs.name: central_valley_pavilion
motifs.description: Small pavilion compound in the central valley beneath the mountain, including layered tile roofs, pale walls, surrounding leafless trees, shrubs, path, and nearby standing figure.
must_preserve: double-tier roof geometry with fine ink eaves
pale wall panels and doorway lines
thin bare tree trunks and twig networks around the buildings
small dark standing scholar figure on the path
soft ochre ground wash and light path curve

motifs.name: right_hillside_pavilion_path
motifs.description: Right-middle pavilion set into a wooded hillside with stone terrace, narrow path, one standing scholar figure, and surrounding bamboo-like and leafy tree brushwork.
must_preserve: compact gabled roof with dark eave lines
rectangular pale wall opening
irregular stone wall blocks beside the path
single robed figure on the path
mixed foliage dots, fine trunks, and pale hillside wash

motifs.name: lower_left_village_grove
motifs.description: Lower-left village cluster nestled in dense trees, with tiled roofs, courtyard walls, blossoming shrubs, a large straight trunk, and layered foliage.
must_preserve: overlapping roof planes and dark roof ridges
courtyard wall linework and small architectural openings
large vertical tree trunk with branching limbs
round blossom-dot shrub clusters
dense black-green foliage masses and fine leaf stippling

motifs.name: lower_right_pavilion_grove
motifs.description: Lower-right pavilion and wooded path scene, including the small raised pavilion, curving path, nearby rocks, dark shrubs, and the small animal-and-attendant group at the far right edge.
must_preserve: rectangular pavilion with pitched roof and thin support lines
curving pale path through the trees
dark rounded shrub masses
rock outlines and pale wash around the building base
tiny animal and attendant figures near the right hillside

motifs.name: foreground_bridge_gorge
motifs.description: Foreground arched bridge crossing a rocky stream gorge, with turbulent water lines, dark boulders, stone embankments, and tiny figures near the bridge approach.
must_preserve: thin arched bridge line and simple rail posts
white-water ripple strokes beneath the bridge
dark foreground boulders with layered ink texture
stone retaining wall blocks at the stream edge
tiny walking figures and path marks near the bridge

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
